status: Prospectively declared before any candidate scores; all comparisons development-only
target: Sum strictly positive quantities with normalized status completed or shipped; include return-flagged fulfilled rows because these represent gross fulfilled demand; exclude returned-only status, cancelled, processing and nonpositive quantities. Deduplicate identical rows; conflicting transaction identifiers fail validation.
returns_sensitivity: Recompute final order quantities excluding return-flagged fulfilled rows; never add returns to usable inventory.
missing_dates: Global ledger contains transactions on every date 2022-01-01 to 2025-11-30. Build a calendar of recorded sales per supplied pair, setting absence to zero recorded transactions conditional on ledger capture, not zero latent demand. No fabricated store-open history. Report sparse frequency and store-date gaps. Routine rejects global missing calendar days within its training range.
population: Same 336 supplied policy/stock pairs for every candidate and origin, all observed in pre-origin training; present-day assortment defines a fixed retrospective population and does not establish historical assortment availability.
training: Each origin uses only dates through origin. Recent means use last 56 or 182 calendar days. Poisson uses at most 156 complete Sunday-ending weeks through origin. No candidate uses future transactions or historical operational snapshots.
evaluation_dates: 2025-09-29 through 2025-11-30 depending on origin and horizon; no December

horizons.secondary: Per pair supplier lead days plus review days, 8 to 14 days. Current rules define retrospective horizon lengths only, not historical inventory simulations.

baseline: 56-calendar-day pair mean times horizon; analytical baseline, not customer incumbent

candidates.name: mean182
candidates.rationale: Longer 26-week mean stabilizes sparse demand; no seasonal extrapolation

candidates.name: poisson
candidates.rationale: Penalized Poisson regression with sparse pair intercepts, calendar-month effects and linear year trend, at most 156 weeks. alpha=0.01, max_iter=300, tol=0.00001; no search.

primary_metric.name: MAE of cumulative next-seven-day fulfilled units
primary_metric.unit: product units per product at a store per origin
primary_metric.weighting: Equal weight to each of 336 pairs and eight origins; no prices or cost weights

selection_rule: Choose lowest pooled primary MAE. Numerical tie within 1e-6 chooses simpler model in order mean56, mean182, poisson. No claimed business-significance threshold. Secondary coverage MAE and signed bias qualify selection, do not replace primary. No later candidate additions planned.
secondary_diagnostics: Primary MAE by origin and store
Empirical error quantiles, descriptive not calibrated future intervals
Final return-treatment and +/-25% demand quantity sensitivity
limitations: Recorded fulfillment is stock constrained and uses final supplied statuses whose old change times are unknown. These are frozen-label development comparisons, not proven live as-of performance. Overlapping coverage horizons are not independent samples. No success gate closure or independent test claim.
